description: Table 1: our watermark against DLM-KGW and dgMARK on WaterBench-600 with LLaDA-8B-Instruct (low-confidence order).

steps.name: ppl
steps.cmd: {PY_EVAL} scripts/score_ppl.py --runs runs/ours_* runs/dlm_kgw_* runs/dgmark_greedy runs/dgmark_top3 --prompts data/waterbench600_llada.jsonl

steps.name: judge
steps.cmd: {PY_EVAL} scripts/judge.py --runs runs/ours_* runs/dlm_kgw_* runs/dgmark_greedy runs/dgmark_top3 --prompts data/waterbench600_llada.jsonl --out judge/main

steps.name: report
steps.cmd: {PY} scripts/report.py --runs runs/ours_* runs/dlm_kgw_* runs/dgmark_greedy runs/dgmark_top3 --thresholds ours=calib/bands.json --thresholds dlm_kgw_=calib/dlm_kgw.json --thresholds dgmark_greedy=calib/dgmark_greedy.json --thresholds dgmark_top3=calib/dgmark_top3.json --judge judge/main/quality.json --contrast ours_d2:dlm_kgw_d2 --contrast ours_d3:dlm_kgw_d3 --out reports/main.json
